design_parameters.enrich_notes: Corpus is from the Florida Stormwater Erosion and Sedimentation Control Inspectors Manual (temporary erosion/sediment and construction dewatering BMPs). It does not define post-construction WQv rainfall depth in inches; atlas WQv (3,600 cf/ac) is not stated in these excerpts.
